extra_quotes: By leveraging the search based on a genetic algorithm and the dataflow encoding used in GAMMA [9], qGAMMA explores a range of possible dataflows and architectural configurations—such as the number of components in each hardware cluster and buffer utilization across memory levels— to identify the characteristics that minimize the chosen metric.
Leveraging MAESTRO [10], we designed an analytical estimation tool supporting multi-precision pipelines and incorporating the changes introduced in qGAMMA.
The genetic algorithm may occasionally converge to suboptimal solutions.
